metrics.profile_summary: Entrepreneurial marketing professional with a background in Economics and a strong track record in lead generation and e-commerce. Expert in Meta Ads and social media growth with experience managing multiple startups.

experience.description: Managed logistics and e-commerce via Shopify, selling 1500+ products and running social media campaigns with a 10% conversion rate.
Generated Rs.1 million in commission sales through strategic automobile trading and organic social media growth.
Executed BTL activities, analyzed advertising results to reduce CPL, and trained new sales agents.
Designed social media content and managed Facebook/Instagram ad campaigns to increase reach and lead generation.

strengths: Strong proficiency in Meta Business Suite and Ads Manager
Proven ability to drive conversions and organic growth
Entrepreneurial experience managing end-to-end marketing and sales
weaknesses: No explicit mention of TikTok or Canva
Lack of traditional full-time corporate employment history
evaluation.summary: The candidate is a strong match with direct experience in social media campaign management and lead generation. He possesses the 'nice-to-have' Meta Business Suite skills and exceeds the minimum experience requirement through his entrepreneurial ventures.
